vendor_freeze.open_failed: Could not open the settings. Follow the steps below in the phone's Settings app.

generic.step_1: Open Settings > Apps > GO > "App battery usage" (or "Battery").

huawei.step_2: Find GO and turn off "Manage automatically".
huawei.step_3: Turn on "Auto-launch", "Secondary launch" and "Run in background".

steps.note_menu_names: Menu names can differ a little between phone models and Android versions.
steps.note_recents: Don't swipe GO away from your recent apps.

oppo.step_2: Tap "Battery usage" and turn on "Allow background activity" (and "Allow auto launch" if shown).

samsung.step_1: Open Settings > Apps > GO > Battery and choose "Unrestricted".
samsung.step_2: In Settings > Battery > "Background usage limits", make sure GO is not in "Sleeping apps" or "Deep sleeping apps".

vivo.step_1: Open Settings > Battery > "Background power consumption management".
vivo.step_3: In Settings > Apps > "Autostart", turn GO on if your phone has it.
